policy: Wrayth Zero-Fake-Data — no demo/seeded/sample/placeholder security data in any product surface. Every screen renders true zero-state driven by real telemetry.
summary: Codebase is largely compliant. Ray components carry defensive comments enforcing the rule ('No fake activity', 'Nothing is hardcoded or mocked', 'render nothing — no placeholder bars'). Only ONE hard offender found and fixed in this pass.

critical_fixed_now.was: Hardcoded fake user roster: Alice Johnson, Bob Williams, Carol Davis, David Brown rendered inside <UsersTeaserContent /> behind a TeaserLock.
critical_fixed_now.now: Replaced with feature-explanation cards (Invite / Enforce MFA / Rotate & Revoke / Role-based Access). No fabricated identities.

acceptable_math_random.reason: Cosmetic progress-bar tick during vault unlock — not telemetry.
Deterministic per-mount seed for greeting variation — not fake data.

acceptable_placeholders.reason: All hits are <input placeholder="..."> hint text (e.g. 'you@example.com', 'John Doe', 'Acme Corp', '4242 4242 4242 4242'). These are form-field guidance, not rendered data. Correct UX pattern — kept.

defensive_comments_confirming_policy: src/components/ray/RayActivityTicker.tsx: 'No fake activity — every line maps to a job'
src/components/ray/RayWatchingCard.tsx: 'status message is derived from real counts — no fake activity'
src/components/ray/AccountHealthPanel.tsx:120: 'No detected accounts + no scores → render nothing (no placeholder bars)'
src/components/ray/DeviceSecurityTabs.tsx: 'Nothing is hardcoded or mocked. If a section has no data the tab still…'
src/pages/safesuite/SafeSuiteDashboard.tsx: 'All data is fetched from real database - no mock data'
src/pages/onboarding/RayOnboarding.tsx:716: 'Calculated from real findings — not a placeholder.'

review_next_phases.note: MRR/ARR labeled '(est.)' and computed from real payment_transactions. When the table is empty it renders $0. Acceptable, but Phase 4 will hide the widget entirely when count === 0 rather than show $0.

false_positives: 'sample'/'malware' terms in IntelligenceMalware.tsx refer to actual customer-submitted malware samples, not fixtures.
'Book a Demo' CTAs in WraythEnterprise.tsx are marketing copy on a public landing.
'Sample submission' in DeviceSecurityTabs.tsx maps to Defender's real telemetry field.
Ticker/greeting/CardName placeholder strings that describe *user input hints* are UX, not data.

next_phases: Phase 2: build src/components/ray/zero-state/ primitives (RayZeroState, RaySetupChecklist, RayNextAction, useHasAnyData).
Phase 5: wrayth_setup_progress table so zero-states share setup signal.

Phase 3: apply primitives to Home → Threat Center → Devices → Investigations → Compliance → Identities → Vault → Graph → Reports → Timeline → Malware → Policies → Attack Paths → Memory. Each page: swap silent-empty with Ray-voice educational zero-state + CTA.
Phase 4: hide zeroed metric widgets on admin (MRR/ARR, RC consumption) when underlying tables are empty; render explanatory copy instead of $0.
Phase 6: contributor README under src/components/ray/zero-state/README.md documenting the rule.
